McNeill offers a biting commentary on various sectors, including politics, business, military, and the media, ultimately questioning the integrity and competence of English institutions. Highlighting the Englishman's blatant arrogance and complacency, the author references the consequences of the Boer War, suggesting that such pride has led to a decline in competence and honor.
